annotation.title_clean: IEEE 7010-2020 IEEE Recommended Practice for Assessing the Impact of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems on Human Well-Being
annotation.title_en: IEEE 7010-2020 IEEE Recommended Practice for Assessing the Impact of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems on Human Well-Being
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society (IEEE SA)
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for IEEE 7010-2020, a recommended practice for assessing the impact of autonomous and intelligent systems on human well-being, using established well-being indices and stakeholder engagement. It supports product development guidance, risk management and performance assessment of intended and unintended impacts.
key_provisions_or_claims: Measures the impact of autonomous and intelligent systems on human well-being
Grounds assessment in scientifically valid well-being indices and stakeholder engagement
Provides guidance for product development, risk management and performance assessment
Helps identify intended and unintended users, uses and impacts
Published May 2020 by IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society
